## What happens after an inquiry

- id: process-after-inquiry
- keywords: after inquiry, what happens, reply, response time, inquiry, contact
- source: ask-marcus-spec §4

After you send an inquiry, the team replies. Your inquiry includes the services and packages you picked and the estimate shown, for reference. No reply time is promised.

## How it works

- id: process-how-it-works
- keywords: how it works, process, steps, how do you work, workflow
- source: landing-page-spec §8

How it works, three steps. 1) We map the workflow, what you need. 2) We build it. 3) We hand it over and maintain it. Start with what you need, one thing is enough.

## What pr-axis dev does not do

- id: process-what-we-dont-do
- keywords: what you don't do, don't do, video, motion, tiers, limits
- source: ask-marcus-spec §4

No per-seat pricing, no subscriptions, no tiers in v1. Video & Motion is held off for now.
